packageRules.description: Test-only infrastructure ships nothing to production, so a bad version can only turn the required 'Build and Test (.NET)' check red, which already blocks the merge. That makes these self-policing, so all update types automerge including majors. Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing and EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory are deliberately NOT listed: although test-only, they belong to the 'dotnet monorepo' group that bumps the whole .NET runtime in lockstep, and matching one member would leak automerge onto that framework-wide PR.
Build-time only: analyzers, polyfill source generators, SourceLink and reproducible-build SDKs emit nothing at runtime, so a bad version fails the build rather than reaching production.
